Toll Brothers

Luxury homes at Panorama

Toll Brothers, America’s Luxury Home Builder®, is a leading builder of luxury homes in the nation’s most desirable locations. Renowned for exceptional craftsmanship, distinctive architecture, and unrivaled personalization opportunities, Toll Brothers creates extraordinary homes and communities while delivering an exceptional home buying experience.

The homes

Homes at Panorama

Elevated in every sense, Toll Brothers at Panorama is an exceptional place to call home. Nestled on a hillside bluff, this new home community in Herriman, UT, places you in a picturesque, perfectly connected setting. Enjoy exquisite views and an exclusive feel from the community’s premier location within the master plan, plus the convenience of quick access to Mountain View Corridor for seamless travel throughout Salt Lake and Utah counties. Choose from an array of modern home designs offering up to 6,000 total square feet on expansive home sites up to half an acre, with walkout basements available on select home designs and a wide range of architectural and personalization options to create a space that beautifully reflects your taste and lifestyle. Experience a new level of luxury living at Toll Brothers at Panorama.

Why Toll Brothers

What sets them apart

  • Premier hillside setting with sweeping mountain and valley views
  • Convenient access to Mountain View Corridor connecting Salt Lake and Utah counties
  • Expansive home sites up to half an acre with select walkout basement opportunities
  • Exceptional personalization opportunities at the Toll Brothers Design Studio
  • Two distinctive collections featuring modern architecture and thoughtfully designed living spaces
